status: Experimental Hecate hardware assumptions used by the exact GLM-5.2 graph-prefill pilot; not a general platform characterization.
evidence_note: This portable summary retains measured inputs and modeling assumptions. Original hardware observations and source captures remain external evidence identified by the hashes below.

rubin_dense_peaks.finding: GPU column: dense BF16 4 PFLOPS, FP8 17.5 PFLOPS, NVFP4 training 35 PFLOPS. Footnote 1 gives DSX MaxLPS factory context; footnote 3 identifies dense figures. Sparse 50 PFLOPS is not used.

architecture.finding: Published architecture has 224 SMs; the observed Hecate devices have 212. No ratio-based peak scaling is assumed.

cuda_bandwidth.finding: Theoretical DDR bandwidth is clock_Hz * bus_bits / 8 * 2. Effective bandwidth counts logical bytes read plus written divided by elapsed seconds; it is distinct from physical traffic.

nvlink_status.finding: nvlink --status reports bandwidth for active links. This documentation does not explicitly specify directionality of that field. The 41 GB/s per-link single-direction interpretation below remains an inference.

xdr_rate.finding: XDR peak link speed is 800 Gbps per direction. Equal sharing of the eight observed ports among four GPUs is a profile assumption, not a verified GPU-to-NIC assignment or throughput result.

memory_bandwidth.classification: Inference using observed maximum clock and interface width with CUDA's DDR formula; not measured sustained HBM throughput.
memory_bandwidth.caveat: NVML snapshots follow synchronized intervals, not an integral. Logical copy traffic and fitted norm traffic are not physical HBM counters. Empirical scaling absorbs the operating state and kernel efficiency; it must not be presented as an isolated hardware efficiency measurement.

memory_op_fit.method: Unweighted ordinary least squares over seven graph medians on GPU 0, with intercept; no end-to-end serving data read or fitted.
memory_op_fit.logical_bytes: 4 * tokens * 6144 * 2 + 6144 * 2; fused residual-add/RMSNorm with BF16 inputs, residuals, outputs and weights
limitations: Absolute-error fitting gives large-token points greater influence on the slope; the largest relative residual is about 33%.
Small arrays can remain in L2 and weights are reused. The model is an effective latency fit, not an HBM characterization.
Only GPU 0 and hidden size 6144 were measured for norm; the same model is provisionally applied to all empirical memory operations.

deepseek_v32.py passes 0.8 as ElementWise's empirical_bw_scaling_factor, but the current native constructor explicitly ignores it for API compatibility. Per-layer timing is 4*T*6144*2/effective_bandwidth + constant, omitting the measured weight vector read. Native checks verify that 0.8 and 1.0 serialize identically.
Prefill graphs are disabled in the serving baseline. Graph norm fitting excludes Python dispatch gaps and does not represent eager frontend/launch overhead.
The serving stack's fused allreduce/residual-add/RMSNorm is not represented by separate allreduce and empirical memory-op terms.

network.intra_node_formula: 36 active links per GPU * 41e9 bytes/s per link = 1.476e12 bytes/s per GPU
network.intra_node_classification: Inferred single-direction link-capacity sum. Status output is rounded and its directionality was not explicitly documented in the cited SMI page. Not a measured P2P or collective bandwidth.
network.inter_node_formula: 8 active ports * 800e9 bits/s / 8 bits_per_byte / 4 GPUs = 2e11 bytes/s per GPU
network.inter_node_classification: Per-direction aggregate line rate with equal sharing; GPU-to-port assignment, PCIe constraints, protocol overhead and simultaneous throughput have not been measured.

network.use_constraint: Required schema values only for this pilot. TP4 measured custom-allreduce with the same TP donor and PP1 must not use these topology fields to scale latency. No topology-based predictions or cross-node claims are authorized by this profile.

required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.name: dense_peak_assumptions
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.vary: Each TC FLOPS field separately and all three jointly at 0.5x and 1.0x published reference; arbitrary stress factors, not estimates or confidence bounds.
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.report: All nine throughput/TTFT/TPOT deltas and query source/clamp/extrapolation behavior. No board-specific peak claim even if sensitivity is small.

required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.name: memory_roofline
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.vary: mem_bw at max-clock and observed-operating-clock references; adjust empirical scaling inversely to hold fitted effective bandwidth and constant fixed.
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.report: Separate roofline/clamp/extrapolation sensitivity from empirical-memory timing.

required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.name: empirical_memory
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.vary: Effective bandwidth at 0.8x, 1.0x and 1.2x fit; constant at fit minus 0.5 us, fit, and fit plus 0.5 us. These are stress factors, not fit confidence intervals.
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.report: All nine metric deltas; retain current SDK operation semantics and document the known fusion/dispatch gap.

required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.name: unused_network_fields
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.vary: intra_node_bw and inter_node_bw separately at 0.5x and 2x while keeping profile identity, data and workload fixed.
required_prediction_sensitivity_checks.report: Require numerically unchanged TP4/EP1/PP1 results (relative tolerance 1e-9); otherwise stop and investigate a topology-dependent path before interpreting predictions.
